A history and geography map the whole school can open.

IntMap runs in a web browser. Students open a link and see the map their teacher chose — no installation and no student accounts.

Send an enquiry Open the map

What a school gets

No student accounts

Everything on the map works without signing in, so no student personal data is needed. Accounts are for people aged 13 and over (Terms §3).

Any device with a browser

Tablets, Chromebooks and PCs with a current browser that supports WebGL. It can also be added to the home screen like an app.

History and the present on one map

Borders from 123,000 BC to today and 165 data layers, each with its source named.

No advertising

IntMap shows no advertising and uses no third-party analytics.

A checklist for IT

The site and the services it loads

Allow the IntMap site itself and the map, data and font services it loads. The privacy policy lists every one of them, with what each receives.

WebGL

The map is drawn with WebGL. A browser or a policy that turns WebGL off shows no map.

Nothing to install

There is no app to distribute and no extension. A link is the whole deployment.

The AI assistant (optional)

Atlas, which answers questions in words, needs an account and has a limit of 10 questions per account per day. The map does not need it.

Lessons

A 50-minute lesson plan, classroom tours, how to make a tour of your own and example maps with questions for class are on the page for teachers.

Questions schools ask

Is there a contract or a school licence?

No. Using the public site in teaching is free and needs no contract. IntMap's software licence allows educational use.

Can a teacher get help planning a lesson?

Yes — write to us. We cannot promise visits or training sessions, but we answer questions about what the map can show.

What if a map shows something wrong?

Tell us through the feedback button in the map or this form. Historical maps are checked against the record, and a reported error is investigated at its source.

What it costs

IntMap is free to use and is paid for by donations. There is no paid plan today. A paid plan for heavier use of the AI features may come later; what it would include and cost has not been decided, and anything free today stays free.

Licences

Every dataset keeps its own licence and credit; the data sources page lists them. The map's credit line names the sources of what is drawn and stays visible in an embed. IntMap's own software is free for personal, educational and non-profit research use; commercial use of the software needs a separate licence (LICENSE §3). If you are unsure which applies to you, ask before you publish.
